description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is hiring an engineer to build, deploy, and support mission-critical services in air-gapped Amazon Dedicated Cloud regions. The role focuses on production troubleshooting, software maintenance, monitoring, automation, and supporting government customers.
Platform Engineering Software Development Engineer maintaining production software, implementing code fixes, developing monitoring, and automating support processes

Responsibilities:
• Troubleshooting, diagnosing and fixing production software issues
• Developing monitoring solutions
• Performing software maintenance and configuration
• Implementing the fix for internally developed code (Perl, Ruby, C/C++, JAVA, Python)
• Updating, tracking and resolving technical challenges
• Working alongside development on AWS projects
• Updating/enhancing our current software
• Automation of support processes and documentation of our systems

Requirements:
• Associate's degree or above, or GSEC (GIAC Security Essentials)
• 1+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
• Experience programming with at least one software programming language
• Current, active US Government Security Clearance of Top Secret with SCI eligibility or above

Preferred:
• Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent
